title: jonesiopsis × tryphera
intro: Jonesiopsis × tryphera, commonly known as Chinese angelica, is a plant species that belongs to the Apiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to promote blood circulation, reduce inflammation, and alleviate menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Jonesiopsis × tryphera include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and estrogenic effects, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as dysmenorrhea and menopausal symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
